FiniteRange.statement: For arbitrary types $\Omega$ and $G$ and a map $X : \Omega \to G$, $\mathrm{FiniteRange}(X)$ is a proposition about $X$; according to its docstring, it is the property of $X$ having a finite range.

FiniteRange.toFinset.statement: For arbitrary types $\Omega$ and $G$ and a map $X : \Omega \to G$ satisfying $\mathrm{FiniteRange}(X)$, $\mathrm{FiniteRange.toFinset}(X)$ is a finite set (Finset) of elements of $G$; according to its docstring, it is the range of $X$, viewed as a finset.
